_note: One line from each meditation, shown on the player while it plays. Each must appear word for word in content/meditations-mall.txt (tools/build-content.py checks it). Change freely.

balance.short: Let yourself be rinsed of what no longer serves you, and begin again, clean and fresh.
balance.extended: Feel the quiet steadiness within you.

luminance.short: Let this moment remind you of the warmth and light that already live within you.
luminance.extended: And as you stay with that feeling, bring your awareness to something deeper — your inner glow.

kindness.short: The aroma deepens, the touch softens, and each movement becomes a quiet expression of kindness towards your body.
kindness.extended: You are enough, just as you are.

serenity.short: For this little moment, you may become that vibrant stillness.

presence.short: With each touch, offer a little love to the body that carries you.
presence.extended: And keep giving your body the tenderness it so willingly receives.
